content:
zoe: heads-up from the eval workshop: our Next.js starter + LangChain eval harness produced inconsistent metrics vs python harness. JS sample reports higher latency and doubled embed counts in some runs.

rahul: can you share the failing eval log and the harness config?

zoe: pasted small excerpts. harness runs two flows: streaming chat + offline embedding eval. JS run shows duplicated embed calls and streaming timeouts: 
```
2026-07-08T08:10:01.001Z INFO eval: starting run js-harness
2026-07-08T08:10:01.102Z WARN sdk: token expiring
2026-07-08T08:10:01.103Z INFO sdk: refresh ok
2026-07-08T08:10:01.104Z INFO sdk: retrying request attempt=1
2026-07-08T08:10:01.105Z INFO embed: starting embed doc=doc-12
2026-07-08T08:10:01.106Z INFO embed: starting embed doc=doc-12 (duplicate)
2026-07-08T08:10:01.210Z ERROR backend embed throttled status=429
2026-07-08T08:10:02.000Z ERROR stream: unexpected stream close
```

zoe: minimal repro from the starter (JS SDK):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await Promise.all([
  client.embeddings.create({ input: 'doc-a' }),
  client.embeddings.create({ input: 'doc-a' })
])
// then run streaming chat which sometimes fails to resume after refresh
```

sam: sounds like a compound issue: (1) duplicate embeds (we've seen this pattern), (2) streaming client not resuming idempotently after refresh/retry. Python harness probably handles retries differently.

aditya: agree. additional wrinkle: JS streaming uses EventSource/chunks and our SDK currently treats refresh as a hard restart which can re-emit partial events. That confuses eval harness which expects at-most-once final output.

rahul: any quick fixes we can ship in the starter before SDK changes?

sam: yes. two small starter changes: (A) coalesce embed calls per-input using a dedupe util (in-memory) for the harness; (B) disable agent-level retries for streaming steps in the eval harness config and let SDK manage stream reconnection policy. Also add explicit idempotency header for non-stream requests.

aditya: SDK plan: expose `x-redwood-idempotency` header, add opt-in `REDWOOD_SDK_STREAM_RESUME=graceful` that will attempt to resume streams with client-side checkpointing instead of full restart, and when refresh happens apply jittered backoff before replaying non-stream requests. Will push PR and doc notes.

zoe: for the eval harness we need deterministic outputs. Sam, can you add a mocked backend run that asserts exactly one embed per doc and no partial stream duplicates?

sam: yes I can add a mock-based e2e that simulates token refresh mid-stream and verifies harness sees single final response and embed call count <=1.

ci-bot: ci/eval-harness job failed in previous run; will re-run after PRs.

docs: small docs change: update streaming troubleshooting with a paragraph about `REDWOOD_SDK_STREAM_RESUME` and a recommended eval harness pattern that avoids overlapping retries between agents and SDKs. 

aditya: timeline: SDK PR for idempotency + stream resume flag tomorrow, starter/eval harness PR with dedupe + tests today. I'll coordinate changelog + migration steps.

zoe: thanks all. tagging @docs to add a short note to the onboarding quickstart about idempotency for batch/indexing and stream resume for chat workloads. Will close after green CI. :thumbsup:
